en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Iibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad Bin Usman, from Al Halby, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘When the slave slanders the free, he would be whipped eighty (lashes)’.
And he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘This is from the rights of the people’.
